name: Casebloom
summary: A support desk with a drag-and-drop case board, live SLA timers and case conversations
about: A dashboard for a support team that takes customer cases from new to solved. Cases move across a board by drag and drop, every case shows a live SLA timer, and each case opens into a conversation with replies, internal notes, saved replies and tags. Customers, agents, help articles, reports and SLA settings sit around it. Good for a help desk, a customer success team or a software product's support.
how: Open the case board and drag a case from New to Open, Waiting or Solved; dropping on Solved makes it bloom, and Undo puts it back.
On a keyboard, focus a case and press Alt with the arrow keys, or use its menu to move it.
Filter the board by text, priority or only your cases; new cases arrive by themselves every so often.
Open a case to read the thread, insert a saved reply, send it or add an internal note, and change status, priority, agent and tags.
Watch the SLA rings count down; waiting cases pause their timer, and you can change the targets in Settings.
Share open cases between online agents on the Team page, and write or edit help articles in Help docs.
Check Reports for cases by channel, ratings, reply times and a when-cases-arrive heatmap.
